title: Elycher
description: A lightweight, zero-config Elytra launcher. Give your survival players a seamless way to fly.
body:
# 🦅 Elycher **The Ultimate Seamless Elytra Launcher for Survival Minecraft** [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Community-7289da?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.com/invite/aFJjYYfNcY) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot-lightgrey?style=for-the-badge)](#) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.21%2B-success?style=for-the-badge)](#) *Tired of awkward high-ground jumps or wasting gunpowder on rockets? Elycher brings cinematic, Iron Man-style takeoffs directly to vanilla Survival.*
--- ### 🚀 Why Elycher? Most flight plugins either break the survival economy or require a master's degree in configuring `yml` files. **Elycher** is built differently. It's a lightweight, drag-and-drop, zero-config utility that feels like it belongs in the vanilla game. No commands, no permissions, no databases-just pure, optimized gameplay. ### ✨ Features * **🔌 Zero Configuration:** Literally plug-and-play. Drop the `.jar` into your `plugins/` folder and restart. Done. * **🎬 Cinematic Launch:** Double-jump while wearing an Elytra to shoot into the air with heavy rocket audio, a custom cloud particle trail, and an automatic wing-pop at the apex. * **⚖️ Survival Balanced:** Built strictly for Survival Mode. Players **must** touch solid ground before launching again, completely preventing mid-air infinite flight abuse. * **⚡ Highly Optimized:** Written with raw performance in mind. Uses smart movement caching to ensure zero TPS drops, even on potato servers. --- ### 📥 Installation & Usage 1. Download the latest `Elycher.jar`. 2. Drop it into your server's `/plugins` directory. 3. Restart your server. 4. **In-Game:** Ensure you are in Survival Mode, equip an Elytra in your chestplate slot, and press `Space` twice to launch! ### 🛑 Note on Anti-Cheats Since Elycher modifies player velocity to launch them, strict anti-cheats (like Vulcan or Grim) might falsely flag the movement. If players experience rubber-banding, ensure you whitelist Elytra boost mechanics in your anti-cheat config. --- ### 🐛 Beta Testing & Support Elycher is currently in **Active Beta**. Found a bug? Have a feature request? Don't leave a bad review-come yell at us directly in the Discord!
